message: Mirrored in Y about Y5: 8 words on 6 blocks. No machine chosen: a word whose reading depends on the machine would refuse the run.

findings.message: Mirroring reverses the cutting direction: climb milling is now conventional milling, and the other way round. Check the cutting data.
A helical move (an arc with a move along the third axis) now turns the other way: a thread milled with it is now the other hand.
